verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LM Studio runs models locally and processes voice data on-device. It also mentions managing models, prompts and configurations and organizing chats in folders. None of this documents retention settings or a way to delete chats or other stored data. Local-only processing is a related privacy property, not a retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
